messages:
Jena (Marketing): Hey team — QuantaForge case study ready to move. Alice from QuantaForge is on thread. Need final customer quote, legal signoff, embargo date, and webinar tie. Alice — any availability next week for a 30m interview?

Alice (QuantaForge): Morning! Yes, Tue/Wed 10–12 PT both work. We can approve the quote after a small wording tweak. Also prefer 'our GPU-backed inference pipeline' instead of generic 'production'.

Mike (Growth): Drafted hero quote + benchmark blurb. Shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/QUANTAFORGE-CASE-DRAFT. Key claim in draft: 2.1x lower latency and ~28% cost per token in production. Can QuantaForge confirm those numbers from your end?

Sam (Legal): Sending standard case release + quote approval form. Please fill and return. Redlines we typically ask for:
```text
- remove customer PII
- include a 30-day embargo option
```

Alice (QuantaForge): Got the release. We redlined the last paragraph: replaced 'production' with 'our GPU-backed inference pipeline' and asked to soften '28%' to 'around 28%'. Uploaded in the doc.

Kyle (CS): Perf snapshot and benchmark notebook uploaded: s3://redwood/quantaforge/perf-2026-03-15. Numbers are steady-state 90th perc latency across 8k seq. Repro steps in the notebook.

Zoe (Product): Webinar idea: 45m joint demo + Q&A, proposed slot Wed Apr 7 11am PT. We'll route registrants to SDR queue 'QF-case-0426'. Who owns the slide deck and demo environment?

Jena (Marketing): I'll own slides + landing. Action list: 1) legal sign + release (Sam/Alice) 2) final quote (Alice/Mike) 3) set embargo date (Sam) 4) webinar slot + routing (Zoe) 5) asset handoff (Dylan for audio/transcript). Target publish date: Apr 14 if legal OK.

Mike (Growth): Proposed final quote (please approve):
```quote
Redwood Inference cut our inference latency by more than half and lowered per-token cost by ~28% — a huge win for our OCR throughput. — Alice, QuantaForge
```

Alice (QuantaForge): Approve with one tweak: change 'more than half' to '2.1x faster' and change 'lowered per-token cost by ~28%' to 'around 28% lower per-token cost'. Otherwise good. :thumbsup:

Sam (Legal): We can approve the release with embargo Apr 14. I've attached the signed release reference: https://legal.redwood/release/12345. No additional redlines beyond the wording tweak.

Dylan (Audio): Uploaded interview audio + transcript: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/quantaforge-interview. Will prep 3x 30s social clips and the full transcript by Thu.

publish-bot: Scheduled publish to blog and newsletter for 2026-04-14T09:00:00Z

Jena (Marketing): Thanks everyone — I'll post final assets by EOD Fri and ping design for hero image. :rocket:
